description: This file defines an Android activity class 'LceDemoActivity' that interacts with Android's ConnectivityManager to monitor network changes and trigger bandwidth updates. It sets up UI components, registers network callbacks, and handles events related to network capability changes.

classes.name: LceDemoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates monitoring network bandwidth via ConnectivityManager, updating UI with network info, and handling user interaction to request bandwidth updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, registers network callbacks, and defines button actions for bandwidth updates.
